meta.name: monopoly-niche-finder
meta.description: Find intersection niches where you're the ONLY voice. Thiel's "competition is for losers" lens. Triggers on: "find my monopoly niche", "blue ocean niche", "unique niche", "niche intersection", "where am I the only one", "zero competition niche", "untapped niche", "category of one", "Thiel monopoly", "dominate a niche", "niche nobody else covers", "cross two domains", "find a niche with no competition", "monopoly positioning", "unique angle for affiliate".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现无人竞争的蓝海市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在寻找独特的市场切入点。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're seeking a unique market angle with no competition.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会引导你提供你的专长或兴趣领域，然后自动交叉生成多个独特的利基市场，并对每个利基进行竞争度、变现潜力等维度评估和排名，最终输出最适合你的垄断利基及内容规划。
howto.when: 当你提到“find my monopoly niche”、“blue ocean niche”、“unique niche”等关键词，或希望找到竞争小、独特利基时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一个没有竞争的垄断利基
say.note: 触发技能，开始利基探索。

say.text: 我的专长是房地产和AI工具，请生成交叉利基
say.note: 提供两个领域，生成利基候选。

say.text: 评估一下AI视频工具对房地产经纪的利基潜力
say.note: 指定具体交叉利基进行深度评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you to provide your expertise or interest areas, then automatically generate multiple unique intersection niches, evaluate and rank each niche on competition, monetization, etc., and output the best monopoly niche with a content roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "find my monopoly niche", "blue ocean niche", "unique niche", etc., or express a desire to find a niche with low competition and uniqueness.

say_en.text: Find a monopoly niche with no competition for me.
say_en.note: Triggers the skill to start niche exploration.

say_en.text: My expertise is real estate and AI tools, generate intersection niches.
say_en.note: Provide two domains to generate niche candidates.

say_en.text: Evaluate the niche of AI video tools for real estate agents.
say_en.note: Specify an intersection niche for deep dive.
